fact_blocks: [F1] ℤ/4 with its order-two subgroup has two ℤ/2 graded pieces and is not isomorphic to their direct sum ([[cex-isomorphic-associated-graded-objects-need-not-give-isomorphic-filtered-objects]]).
step_uses: 1.1 Put the filtered A=ℤ/4 of [F1] in chain degree zero and zero elsewhere, using [F5]. Every differential of C is zero. Hence $A^r_{p,0}=F_pA$ and the page denominator is $F_{p-1}A$ for every r, so the pages have ℤ/2 at (0,0) and (1,-1), zero elsewhere, and all page differentials vanish. Thus the sequence collapses from page zero by [F3]. [F1, F3, F5, F6, F7]

2.1 Its homology is A in degree zero with exactly the given filtration; finite convergence [F2] identifies these two stable pieces with its graded homology. The quotient A→A/{0,2}≅ℤ/2 cannot have a section: the image of 1 would have to be 1 or 3 modulo 4, but either doubles to 2, while a homomorphism from ℤ/2 must send 1 to an element killed by 2. Therefore the extension does not split in the sense of [F4]. [F1, F2, F4, step 1.1] ∎
